from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    background = Counter(x for row in grid for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]

    row_bounds = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid)
                  if sum(x != background for x in row) >= 0.7 * w]
    col_bounds = [c for c in range(w)
                  if sum(grid[r][c] != background for r in range(h)) >= 0.7 * h]

    # The grid-line color is the most common non-background color on boundaries.
    line_counts = Counter()
    for r in row_bounds:
        line_counts.update(x for x in grid[r] if x != background)
    for c in col_bounds:
        line_counts.update(grid[r][c] for r in range(h) if grid[r][c] != background)
    line_color = line_counts.most_common(1)[0][0]

    out = []
    for i in range(len(row_bounds) - 1):
        row = []
        for j in range(len(col_bounds) - 1):
            corners = [
                grid[row_bounds[i]][col_bounds[j]],
                grid[row_bounds[i]][col_bounds[j + 1]],
                grid[row_bounds[i + 1]][col_bounds[j]],
                grid[row_bounds[i + 1]][col_bounds[j + 1]],
            ]
            if corners[0] != line_color and all(x == corners[0] for x in corners):
                row.append(corners[0])
            else:
                row.append(background)
        out.append(row)
    return out
